correctness.rationale: For the line graph of the 20-vertex nonbipartite dodecahedron, 0<h<4J makes exactly one down spin per triangle the unique local minimizing pattern; compatible assignments correspond bijectively to 36 perfect matchings of D. Independently enumerating 36 matchings, computing all co-occupancies K, and evaluating Q=K−4 11^T gives exact integer identities Q²=24Q, BQ=0, trQ=240. This determines an orthogonal projector Q/24 of rank 10; since unsigned vertex-edge incidence B has rank 20 by connected odd cycles, its range equals kerB. Hence Cov(n)=Q/36=(2/3)P and Cov(sigma)=(8/3)P. The adjacency A_G=B^T B−2I and fluctuation-dissipation χ/β=Cov_beta(sigma), with positive energy gap, prove the spectral and zero-temperature statements. Direct independent finite enumeration also verified 900 Q-products, 36 matchings, and rank ten; the finite graph makes exhaustive enumeration an adequate certificate here when its code is checked.

final_claim: Uniform 36-state Ising plateau on the icosidodecahedron has occupancy covariance (2/3)P_kerB and spin covariance/Curie coefficient (8/3)P, exactly ten equal nonzero flat-band modes and a complete 435-pair pinning table.
limitations: Only homogeneous classical 30-spin cluster, zero-temperature Gibbs limit with zero probe field and 0<h<4J; no finite-temperature exact covariance identity or quantum many-body state conclusion.
